# SD13-E5 deterministic Human Rogue level 7 progression fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD13-E3/E5 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Rogue
# level-1/level-2/level-3/level-4/level-5/level-6 chassis baseline to level 7
# as chosen input only. It names selections; it does not contain derived,
# computed, or parity values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice
# seam (ability-bonus and bonus-feat) and the deterministic ability/feat/
# skill posture from the level-1/level-2/level-3/level-4/level-5/level-6
# fixtures, adding only the level bump this bounded tranche needs. Rogue
# grants no talent choice-slot line here (rogue talents are a level-2+/4+/6+
# choice-list feature this slice deliberately does not implement — a
# genuinely open-ended talent tree, not a flat arithmetic burden), so no new
# choice= line is required beyond the level-1..level-6 baseline.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Rogue burden surface: no check-execution
# engine, no trap DC resolution, no magic-trap disarm engine, no rogue
# talent, and no level-8+ progression. The PF1 Core Rulebook Rogue class
# table's level-7 "Special" column reads "Sneak attack +4d6" only (verified
# independently against d20pfsrd and legacy.aonprd.com) — the sneak attack
# die count genuinely rises to 4 (i.e. 4d6) via the pre-existing (level + 1)
# / 2 formula, unchanged from level 6's formula; Trap Sense's own flat
# magnitude stays at +2 (rogue level / 3, floor: 7 / 3 = 2, unchanged from
# level 6 — the next Trap Sense rise is at 9th level, beyond this bounded
# slice); Trapfinding stays at +3 (max(7 / 2, 1) = 3, unchanged from level 6,
# an integer-division coincidence); no other new class feature is named at
# level 7.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-rogue-level7

race_id=race:human
class_level=class:rogue:7
ability=strength:10
ability=dexterity:17
ability=constitution:12
ability=intelligence:12
ability=wisdom:10
ability=charisma:10
feat=feat:weapon_finesse
skill=skill:stealth:1
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:dexterity
